rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0003, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-14 (one knob vs iter-12 best). NUMBERS n_bands(n_outer1): 12->hr0.0240, 16->0.0268, 24->0.0299(iter-12 BEST), 32->0.0270(iter-13 DOWN) -> n_bands has an INTERIOR OPTIMUM at 24 (bracketed: 16 and 32 both lower). LOCK n_bands=24. FAILURE MODE: soft_thresh was tuned at n_bands=6 (light 0.0007 best); at 24 bands the step-1 recon is finer/cleaner so the residual correction has different noise stats -> the thresh optimum likely shifted. ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0007 -> 0.0003 (lighter, n_bands locked 24). HYPOTHESIS: if at 24 bands the single-pass residual is cleaner, keeping MORE of it (lighter thresh 0.0003) adds back more true structure and lowers RMSE -> hr above 0.0299; if lighter lets residual noise through (hr down), the thresh optimum at 24 bands is >=0.0007 and I sweep heavier. Budget: ~seconds.
